log.text: You cross into Aravel mid-stride: a valley road at dusk, two moons rising, a warm unreadable coin and an iron key-ring you did not put in your pockets.

lines: Talent: THE LINK — classification: none. No precedent on record.
log.title: Registration

log.text: Across the valley a manor stands on a shoulder of hill — Hearthholt, says the brass tag. One high window is lit. It was not lit a moment ago. The road forks: down toward distant town lights, or up to the iron gate.

You take the right fork and climb the switchback to Hearthholt's iron gate. Up close the house is in far better repair than an empty house should be — clean gutters, swept chimneys — and the lit gable window holds steady the whole way up.

A lantern climbs behind you: Amy Laurens, up from Amberford, keeper of the house's affairs these many years. She sets down a supper basket she admits she packed before she knew whom she'd meet — and asks who it is she's feeding.

skills.name: Patternwork
skills.note: Systems-thinking: seeing how a thing's parts drive it — plans, mechanisms, markets, people-in-groups.

skills.name: Even Keel
skills.note: Calm under load: pressure does not reach the hands or the voice.

skills.name: Appraisal
skills.note: Judging worth, quality, and provenance at a look.

titles.name: Talent: The Link
titles.note: Each woman I am fully intimate with becomes permanently linked to me; each of us chooses one attribute or skill of the other, gaining a permanent boost that grows as the other's linked attribute or skill grows. — Classification: none. No precedent on record.
